capabilities.summary: Plan a character-sticker workflow with explicit character and sample approvals, then finish supplied transparent motion frames with authored timing and captions.
useWhen: The user requests character-based animated chat stickers and can review character references and actual samples.
The user supplies existing registered transparent motion frames for bounded local compositing.
doNotUseWhen: The task requires this helper to generate natural character motion, rigging, interpolation or identity repair.
The task is automatic publishing, rights clearance, sale or platform certification.

output.description: Stage-dependent human-readable design and delivery summary. The finishing helper emits files and a technical report, not a strict API for the whole creative workflow.

permissions: Read task-scoped reference material and user-provided artwork.
Write new local output files to an approved destination.
Use image or video services only under the applicable data-sharing and payment authorization.
sideEffects: Creates local PNG, GIF, HTML and JSON outputs, copies source frames and supplied manifest/rights records.

when: Confirm the chosen character reference before motion production and actual samples before batching.
Obtain required authorization before external sharing, paid generation, publication or sale.
